title: Hana
dek: A name associated with the tower near Larkhollow, a small doll and a dangerous larger presence whose relationship remains unclear.
body:
Hana enters the continuation as someone Ryvyt regards as a friend living in the tower near Larkhollow. His suspicion that she and a guarding creature might be the same being is a theory, not an established identity.

The tower encounter

A voice identified as Hana refuses to let the visitors discover what the tower keeps hidden. The small figure falls inert as a doll; a distorted presence appears, guardians Tik and Tok attack, and a larger attacking figure is subsequently called Hana. Oya, Ryvyt and Pelagia escape.

What the tower protects, who controls the doll, and whether all manifestations share a single identity remain unanswered. Sylvi Fernstep later claims Lady Hana is older than local accounts suggest, without supplying a verified age or origin.
